expected_form.problema: The lab minisplit won't start: a click is heard in the outdoor cabinet but the fan doesn't spin and the compressor won't start; the breaker tripped several times the day before and kept being reset.
expected_form.diagnostico: Swollen start capacitor with oil seepage around the terminal; the contactor chatters when energized.
expected_form.solucion: Replaced the 45+5 µF 370 V start capacitor and the two-pole 30 A contactor with 24 V coil; cleaned the drain and tightened every terminal. The unit started and cooled normally.
expected_form.notas: The breaker is fine; ask the school staff not to keep resetting it so much.

user_utterances.text: Morning... yeah, I made it to the school, the caretaker opened the computer lab for me... starting with the order for the minisplit that won't start, right?

So here's the thing... I hit power and nothing, I mean, you hear a click in the outdoor cabinet but the fan doesn't move... and the compressor won't start either... yesterday the breaker tripped like three times, the guys kept resetting it and ten minutes later it went again.

Hold on, let me take off the side panel... there... ok, here it is... the start capacitor is swollen, real fat, and a little oil has seeped out around the terminal... uh... and the contactor, when I power it up, chatters bad.
The factory one, I guess... here on the label it says forty five plus five, at three hundred seventy volts... it's the forty five plus five one.
The contactor is getting a new one too, it's hammering... it's the two pole one, thirty amps, with a twenty four volt coil... just one.
Panel's back on... there... powering it up... there it goes... the compressor kicked on, fan spinning fine, cold air coming out now... the machine is good.
So... I changed the start capacitor and the contactor, gave the drain a quick clean because it had slime... tightened every terminal... and all in all it took me... let's see... about fifty minutes.
Yeah... note that the breaker is fine, and that they should tell the school staff not to keep resetting it so much... that's all, send it.
